source.name: Federal Reserve Distributional Financial Accounts
source.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

asset_classes.label: Stocks & Mutual Funds
asset_classes.blurb: Directly held corporate equities plus mutual fund shares.

asset_classes.label: Private Business Equity
asset_classes.blurb: Ownership of noncorporate businesses -- partnerships, S-corps, sole proprietorships.

asset_classes.label: Pensions & Retirement
asset_classes.blurb: Defined benefit and defined contribution pension entitlements.

asset_classes.label: Real Estate
asset_classes.blurb: Owner-occupied housing and other real property.

asset_classes.label: Cash & Deposits
asset_classes.blurb: Checkable deposits, currency, time deposits and short-term investments.

asset_classes.label: Bonds
asset_classes.blurb: Treasury, municipal, corporate and foreign bonds held directly.

asset_classes.label: Consumer Durables
asset_classes.blurb: Vehicles, appliances, furnishings -- counted as assets by the Fed, not investments.

asset_classes.label: Life Insurance
asset_classes.blurb: Cash value of life insurance reserves.

asset_classes.label: Loans Receivable
asset_classes.blurb: Mortgages and other loans held as assets.

asset_classes.label: Unallocated
asset_classes.blurb: Residual between the Fed's published asset total and the categories above, caused by a definitional change in the deposits series.
